A '''Podracing course''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]], a [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], was considered to be the crowd favorite. It was the third and final race of the [[Outer Rim Regional Podracing Circuit]].
